prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1145; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision on the date referenced in your file. Our client was struck on the driver's side by a vehicle that entered the intersection against the signal, causing significant injury and ongoing medical treatment. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide, within thirty days, a certified copy of the declarations page for every policy that may apply to this loss, including the stated bodily injury and property damage limits and any umbrella or excess coverage. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether coverage is being disputed.

Please ensure that all evidence in your possession relating to this collision is preserved. This includes the insured's recorded statements, photographs, claim notes, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or event data, and any dash camera or witness material. Destruction or alteration of such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
